testimonials.title: What Our Users Say
testimonials.subtitle: Join thousands of movie enthusiasts who have found their perfect watch with MovieMate.

testimonial1.text: MovieMate has completely transformed how I discover films. The recommendations are spot-on, and I've found so many hidden gems I would have never known about!

testimonial2.text: The social features are amazing! I love being able to see what my friends are watching and share my favorite movies with them. It's like having a movie club in your pocket.

testimonial3.text: I've discovered so many international films through MovieMate. The curated collections are fantastic, and the app makes it easy to explore different genres and cultures.
